This is the government drinking-water baseline only. More water is needed for cooking, washing and other tasks.

Example: 2 people × 3 litres × 3 days = 18 litres of drinking water.

What this number means

The baseline is not a target for stockpiling or a prediction that services will fail for three days. It is a simple planning quantity for short-term disruption.
